svg.title: Key takeaways
svg.desc: For most of the 50 Qwen3-32B neurons we examined, strongly activating texts showed clear semantic, syntactic, or word-form patterns. We still struggle to use these patterns to explain weak activations or predict exactly which token in a sentence will activate strongly.
